title: Quick prompts as files
highlights: Quick prompts can live as one-prompt-per-file Markdown documents in ~/.jcode/prompts: the file name becomes the slash command and edits apply immediately without a restart
improvements: New quick prompts appear in the / palette as soon as the config file changes, without restarting the session
A custom prompt directory can be set with [prompts] dir in config.toml, and inline [prompts] entries still work alongside prompt files
fixes: Quick prompts added to config.toml no longer stay invisible in the slash palette until a restart
